findings.title: GitHub owner admin profile is published on the public leaderboard with no opt-out

The admin UI hides ProfilePreferences (identity-panel.tsx:210) and /api/profile uses the guest-only service, so the owner cannot opt out. The full PostgreSQL run at 19:32 failed TR-30 with exactly one extra public row (a bare runtime UUID, unlike test-local admin- ids), and the next green run followed test cleanup changes; no product analysis was recorded (inference on the row identity).
